what: tools/shc_cc.py persistent locked compiler slots + in-process rof2elf, against the committed per-compile temp copy (cac721e)
method: For every src/*.c unit the exact compiler input dc_build.py uses (build/pp/<unit>.c when the source has quoted includes, else src/<unit>.c) was compiled once with the old script and once with the new one, each in a fresh python -I process, frozen flags (-v shc-v5.1r11 --no-default-flags -- -speed -noinline). The SYSROF .obj and the rof2elf .elf were compared with tools/objcmp.py, which blanks only the 12-digit compile-time stamp in the SYSROF 0x04/0x06 header blocks (and drops the per-block checksum byte that covers it) and the same stamp in the ELF .comment; everything else must be byte-identical. obj_raw_identical counts units whose raw .obj bytes were identical (never, since the stamp has one-second resolution). obj_same_as_build_obj compares the new .obj with the one kept in build/obj from the committed state.
